Build a randomized Williams cross-over design and schedule

Source: R/williams.r
ks_williams.Rd

R analogue of the SAS \codeWILLIAMS macro. The function constructs a Williams design from a randomized cyclic Latin square and generates a block-randomized subject schedule.

Usage

ks_williams(tmts_num, tmt_names, sample_size, out_rtf = NULL, seed_num = NULL)

Arguments

tmts_num

Integer number of treatments.

tmt_names

Character vector of treatment labels (length must equal \codetmts_num).

sample_size

Integer target number of subjects.

out_rtf

Optional output file path. If provided, a simple RTF report with design and randomization schedule tables is written.

seed_num

Optional integer seed. If \codeNULL, current system time is used.

Value

A list with: \describe \itemdesignData frame of Williams sequences by period. \itemscheduleData frame of randomized subject assignments. \itemseedSeed used. \itemseed_generatedLogical; \codeTRUE when seed was auto-generated. \itemn_sequencesNumber of unique sequences. \itemblock_numNumber of full randomization blocks used. \itemsample_size_warningLogical; \codeTRUE when \codesample_size is not a multiple of \coden_sequences.
